Sylvie: Quick postmortem follow-up from the regional surge rehearsal. Saw three repeat blips: route reconciliation races, eu snapshot skew, and healthcheck noise. Need owners + short timelines.
Diego: I can take route reconciliation. Hypothesis: publisher vs reconciler race. Plan: add idempotency token + post-publish reconcile. Target: 6 business days.
Jamal: I'll own snapshot skew + restore verification. Plan: nightly quick-restore (schema-only) to tiny instance, emit restore_time metric. ETA: 4 days.
Keiko: I'll update the restore runbook and schedule the dry-run game day. Prefer Sun 05/18 04:00 PT to avoid peak. Will add pre-flight checklist.
Sylvie: Thanks. Add conservative canary: 0.5% traffic, circuit-break to origin if error >2% for 3m. Keep manual approval for >5%.
Diego: Will add route-diff metric and a rollback endpoint. Posting PR under ff/route-stability-2026 soon.
Jamal: Smoke-restore snippet I'm prototyping: ```bash
SNAP=$(aws ec2 describe-snapshots --filters "Name=tag:env,Values=prod" --query 'Snapshots[-1].SnapshotId' --output text)
aws ec2 wait snapshot-completed --snapshot-ids $SNAP
# attach to t3.small, run basic app smoke checks
```
